bib.title: PaLI-X: On Scaling up a Multilingual Vision and Language Model

question: What does scaling both the vision encoder (to 22B) and the language encoder-decoder (to 32B) of a multilingual vision-language model, with a broad objective mixture, buy across captioning, VQA, document, video, few-shot, classification and detection tasks?
hypothesis: Scaling both V&L components together, with a mixture of objectives, improves performance and the few-shot vs fine-tuning Pareto frontier.
contributions: Scale a V&L model to 55B, showing scaling both components helps and is unsaturated
Mixture of prefix-completion and masked-token objectives improves the few-shot vs fine-tuning Pareto frontier
ViT-22B co-trained on image classification and OCR label classification improves text-in-image tasks
SoTA via fine-tuning on 15+ benchmarks; multitask fine-tuning across diverse benchmarks without significant degradation

method.summary: PaLI-X pairs a ViT-22B (further trained with JFT classification plus OCR bag-of-words classification) with a UL2-initialised 32B encoder-decoder. Visual patch embeddings are projected and concatenated with text embeddings. It is trained in two stages on a 13-objective mixture (frozen ViT at 224px, then OCR/detection-only at rising resolution up to 756px), then fine-tuned per task or multitask.
method.task: multilingual image/video captioning, VQA, document understanding, few-shot captioning, classification, detection

datasets.name: WebLI
datasets.size: roughly one billion images with alt-texts and OCR, over 100 languages
datasets.source: PaLI [5]; OCR via GCP Vision API

datasets.name: Episodic WebLI
datasets.preprocessing: loosely related images clustered by URL

datasets.name: COCO Captions, NoCaps, TextCaps, VizWiz-Cap, Screen2Words, Widget-Cap; VQAv2, OKVQA, TallyQA, TextVQA, VizWiz-VQA, STVQA, OCRVQA, InfographicVQA, DocVQA, AI2D, ChartQA, OVEN, InfoSeek
datasets.split: COCO Karpathy split; val/test-dev/test as in tables
datasets.preprocessing: training sets deduplicated against test images of all tasks

datasets.name: Video: MSR-VTT, VATEX, ActivityNet Captions, SMIT, NExT-QA, MSR-VTT-QA, ActivityNet-QA
datasets.size: Table 24; 10% or more videos missing in most (e.g. MSR-VTT train 4768 of 6513)
datasets.split: validation for early stopping, test reported
datasets.preprocessing: up to 8 or 16 frames, fixed temporal stride per dataset

datasets.name: LVIS / COCO detection
datasets.preprocessing: LVIS-rare labels removed from pretraining detection data; LVIS and COCO labels removed for zero-shot

models.name: PaLI-X
models.layers: 50 in both encoder and decoder (up from 32 in UL2)

training.objective: mixture: span corruption (15% of tokens), split-captioning, CC3M captioning, split-ocr, VQA (VQ2A, Object-Aware), VQG, episodic captioning, 4-pair VQA, pix2struct, video captioning (4 frames), OWL-ViT pseudo-label detection, ViT-VQGAN image-token prediction (256 tokens at 256x256)
training.batch_size: fine-tuning: 256 (COCO, VQAv2, OCRVQA, multitask) or 128 (all other)

other.stage 2: only pix2struct, split-ocr and detection objectives; resolution raised to 448, 672, 756
other.ViT-22B OCR tuning: JFT classification plus multilabel OCR-token-occurrence classification (mT5 tokenizer, expanded head)
other.multitask FT: about 5M examples, 20k steps at batch 256; 672px captioning, 756px VQA; same prompt without task indicators
other.few-shot pretraining: up to 4 shots, Ne sampled uniformly 1..N
other.few-shot FT: up to 8 encoder shots, no decoder shots
other.detection: Pix2seq-style, coords 0-999, prompt 'detect a and b', separate detection-specific model fine-tuned after the 672 stage

inference.samples: few-shot: shots pool of 256 train examples, N shots drawn at random per test point; seeds not stated
inference.prompting: 'Generate caption in ⟨lang⟩'; 'Answer in ⟨lang⟩: {question}'; detection 'detect class1 and class2'; optional OCR tokens from GCP Vision API as extra text

parameters.attention re-weighting: cross-attention weights multiplied by N (total shots) for target image and prompt tokens
parameters.video frames: 8 or 16, no spatial pooling, 16x16 patches per frame
parameters.fine-tune resolution: 672x672 for end-to-end captioning/VQA, 756x756 for scene-text and document tasks, 224x224 for video

metrics.name: VQA accuracy / EM / ANLS / relaxed accuracy
top-1 accuracy
metrics.definition: exact match of generated class name

eval.protocol: single run per setting, no seeds or significance tests stated; multitask fine-tuning uses a single checkpoint for all tasks

availability.data: WebLI and other mixture components not released in the text

limits: Pretraining optimizer, lr, warmup, batch size, hardware and compute are not stated; WebLI and several mixture sources are not released
No seeds or variance; single runs
Few-shot VQA lags Flamingo; authors attribute to fine-tuning the language backbone (tension between few-shot and fine-tuning)
Multitask FT loses 7.3 on Screen2Words and COCO needs longer training
Video datasets are missing 10% or more of videos, so numbers are not on the original splits
Fairness analysis limited: toxicity judged on captions only, attributes inferred by tools
Counting emergence read from only four model sizes; ablations use a 5B or 700M proxy
Comparisons with GIT2 etc. use different resolutions and SCST on VATEX (footnote)
